author: Solenia Suarez
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C", name = "Cylinders") +
  labs(
    title = "The Weight of Efficiency",
    subtitle = "Heavier cars tend to travel fewer miles per gallon",
    x = "Weight (1,000 lb)",
    y = "Fuel efficiency (mpg)",
    caption = "Each point is a car in the built-in mtcars dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
